The Fortran sources in this directory are copied from the JTTY mode codec
in wsjtx-3.3.0-beta5 (a WSJT-X fork), unmodified except where noted in this
project's commit history. They are licensed under the GNU General Public
License v3 (see COPYING in this directory); this project links them under
the same terms.

Entry points used by JttyChat (see ../../src/JttyCodec.h):
  genjtty_text_c    - encode text to tone symbols
  gen_jttywave_     - render tone symbols to a GFSK audio waveform
  rjtty_sub_        - scan a receive buffer for JTTY frames
  jtty_get_updates_ - drain decoded messages

Local modifications: jtty_mdecode.f90 and rjtty_sub.f90 carry each frame's
SNR and symbol-error count through to jtty_get_updates (which therefore
returns snrs/nerrors instead of upstream's integer snr argument).
